title: Add protocol info compatibility fixtures
summary: Lock protocol_info wire compatibility with explicit JSON fixtures and tests so stale clients can probe IPC/HTTP version metadata without guessing schema drift.
expectedFailureModes: A refactor changes protocol_info JSON keys and stale clients break during the unauthenticated probe.
Newer daemons add required protocol info fields without defaults, causing older CLIs to fail deserializing the probe response.
Docs describe protocol negotiation while leaving compatibility rules implicit, leading to accidental breaking changes.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd protocol_info --locked
nextAction: Integrated fixture-backed protocol_info contract; keep v1 fixtures stable and bump protocol version before introducing required schema changes.
